# Phase 6B: Corrected Null Statistics

## Corrected null statistics

- Expected Jaccard is computed exactly from the hypergeometric distribution: ``E[J] = sum_x x/(2k-x) P(X=x)``.
- Chance-adjusted Jaccard = (observed - E[J]) / (1 - E[J]).
- Permutation p-value uses finite-sample correction ``(b+1)/(B+1)`` with B=4999.
- The non-standard prevalence-adjusted agreement has been removed; only raw agreement, Cohen kappa, and MCC are reported.
